Learn more Learn more Config 2027 at a glance 75+ speakers 50+ sessions 8k+ attendees Why attend What you’ll learn At Config, you’ll hear from the world’s leading product builders on the future of design and product development. You’ll also be the first to dive into Figma’s newest products and features. Discover how these updates can help you stay ahead and unlock new ways of building as disciplines blur and evolve. Who you’ll meet Over 8,000 designers, developers, marketers, and product leaders attend Config every year to share creative ideas, network, and find new ways to push the boundaries of product building. You’ll have the chance to meet big-picture thinkers and everyday makers who love their craft, and connect with a community that’s moving innovation forward. What to expect Attend inspiring keynotes from the visionaries shaping products you know and love, level up your Figma skills with hands-on demos, and dig into insightful product design topics during deep-dive sessions. You’ll walk away with fresh ideas, practical takeaways, and new connections to inspire your next project. Memorable moments Highlights from Config 2026 The rules are the art: creating with AI Holly Herndon The hidden craft of interface design in modern film Jayse Hansen The canvas is not dead Catt Small Turning real world motion into design Patrick Flaherty Death of the finished state Brent David Freaney Figma deep dive: Motion Dave Hornsby, Daniela Muntyan, & Luca Damasco Questions Frequently asked questions Can I apply to speak at Config? Yes! Speaker applications for Config are accepted from October 19, 2026 through November 16, 2026. Check out our speaker resources page for more information. When and where is Config? Config will be held at Pier 80 . Opens in a new tab in San Francisco from May 25–27, 2027. We recommend you use public transportation . Opens in a new tab or your preferred rideshare to get there.
